discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 of B026. 30 standard WebSearch queries, blocked domains passed, all search_snippet. Keys reused from packets 234/335. New pins from MyPinCentral per-pin pages: MNSSHP Gaston, Pixar Villains Darla & Nemo (LE 300), Pixar Party mystery 6/8 Chip and Dale (held). New sets: Pixar Villains box, Pixar letters frame (held). Added set sizes: topiary LE 500, MVMCP box 1,000/frame 300, MNSSHP mystery 12, goodbye LE 1,100. Resellers (yourwdwstore, walmart, madhouse, bonanza, pristineauction) and forums used as leads only. No holds released; topiary and bronze holds kept. No prompt-injection seen.
